questions.prompt: You want to raise a $20 bet to $60. The cleanest action is…

choices.text: Say 'raise to sixty' before moving extra chips.
Place $20, watch, then go back for $40.
Throw one chip and say nothing.
Announce the raise after the next player folds.

questions.explanation: A clear amount avoids a string-bet ruling.

questions.prompt: Facing a bet, one oversized chip without comment is often ruled…

choices.text: A call, unless you state a raise.

questions.explanation: The one-chip rule usually means call. Announce the raise first.

questions.prompt: Action folds to you and you may check. You should not be offered…

choices.text: A free fold as if someone had bet.

questions.explanation: Do not fold when checking is free. Folding for free gives up the pot.

questions.prompt: You are unsure whether an all-in reopened the action. You…

choices.text: Ask the dealer before you act.

questions.explanation: Reopening rules are procedural. The dealer rules; the floor can review.
